keyEvents.text: Goal! Cray Wanderers 1, Stockport County 0. Sammie McLeod (Cray Wanderers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Olajuwon Ogunwamide following a fast break.
Luca Ashby-Hammond (Stockport County) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Stockport County. Oliver Whatmuff replaces Che Gardner.
Goal! Cray Wanderers 2, Stockport County 0. Alex Hernandez (Cray Wanderers) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
First Half ends, Cray Wanderers 2, Stockport County 0.
Substitution, Stockport County. Ethan Pye replaces Tom Wilson-Brown.
Substitution, Stockport County. Jack Diamond replaces Benony Andrésson.
Eoghan O'Connell (Stockport County) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Ethan Pye (Stockport County) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Stockport County. Kyle Wootton replaces Jason Adigun.
Alex Hernandez (Cray Wanderers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Olajuwon Ogunwamide (Cray Wanderers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Cray Wanderers. Lateef Adaja replaces Olajuwon Ogunwamide because of an injury.
Substitution, Cray Wanderers. Seidou Sanogo replaces Frankie Raymond.
Goal! Cray Wanderers 2, Stockport County 1. Kyle Wootton (Stockport County) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Josh Dacres-Cogley.
Substitution, Cray Wanderers. Tobi Tinubu replaces Bayli Spencer-Adams.
Substitution, Cray Wanderers. Soul Kader replaces Ade Yusuff.
Goal! Cray Wanderers 2, Stockport County 2. Mikaël Mandron (Stockport County) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Stockport County. Jay Mingi replaces Josh Dacres-Cogley.
Goal! Cray Wanderers 2, Stockport County 3. Lewis Fiorini (Stockport County) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Cray Wanderers. Alfie Payne replaces Alex Hernandez.
Substitution, Cray Wanderers. Shae Hutchinson replaces John Ufuah.
Substitution, Stockport County. Richard Ilara replaces Mikaël Mandron.
Second Half Extra Time begins Cray Wanderers 2, Stockport County 3.
Delay in match because of an injury Jay Mingi (Stockport County).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
